notes: Posted 17 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card (Coruscant and Imperial City are the Special Edition sites), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards are marked '(start)' in the list: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Boonta Eve Podrace, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Prince Xizor, Sebulba's Podracer, Watto's Box and Start Your Engines!; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Coruscant(start)' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition), the system Agents Of Black Sun deploys with Imperial City; 'CoruscantImperial City' dested Coruscant: Imperial City (not the Virtual page).

Posted 'TatooinePodrace Arena', 'Boonta Eve Podrace' and 'Jabba's PalaceAudience Chamber' dested the Dark pages; 'Boba Fett in Slave1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Ommni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Start Your Engines' Start Your Engines! (missing from the machine draft, added).
Secret Plans and No Escape are the 2001 Effects, not the later Defensive Shield pages.
The post claims an 8-0 record in sanctioned play, with no named event; kept as a general deck.
